policy.parityRequired: Všechny16 hodnot matic, fade, slot/count a bounds musí být shodné.
policy.sparseAcceptance: Pro sparse-1 a sparse-32 ve všech třech velikostech alespoň4 z5 párů rychlejší a medián párových poměrů candidate/baseline <1.
policy.regressionGate: Stabilní regrese je medián párových poměrů >1.1 a alespoň4 z5 párů >1.1 v kterémkoli ostatním scénáři.
policy.primaryMetric: Průměr celého mutate+flush v každém párovém bloku; samotný nested flush nestačí.
policy.dataPolicy: Zachovat každý raw vzorek včetně outlierů a všechny úspěšné i neúspěšné kampaně. Případnou další kalibraci výslovně zdůvodnit, nikdy nenahradit původní data.

firstAdmission.reason: Two submicrosecond controls breach the predefined gate; retain all data and investigate longer outer-clock blocks before accepting or changing runtime.

limitations: CPU component only, not game FPS/GPU.
Short submicrosecond samples are superseded for admission by explicitly recorded longer-block controls; original data retained.
Full-churn/rebound have variable paired results: no universal speedup claimed; median regressions remain reported even when they do not meet the predefined four-of-five stability rule.

method.scope: CPU wall time on real PhotoGrassBatch/NullEngine; no render, GPU, FPS or browser claim
method.clock: performance.now; three clock reads per operation on both variants
method.timing: total mutate+flush includes add/remove bookkeeping and rebound allocation/copy; nested flush is contained in total, never add them
method.capacity: Unmodified real default FAR capacity cap floor(280000/22)=12727; rebound doubles until clamped by that cap. Actual final capacity is recorded.
method.preparation: Geometry, material, roots and transform arrays are created outside timing. Tail is restored with add+flush between samples; rebound has a fresh N-capacity fixture before each timed append+flush. No forced GC.
method.sparse: sparse-1/32 recycle 1/32 non-tail roots using remove+append; both calls are inside total. This changes at most 2/33 numeric slots at fixed N.
method.order: five pairs by default; A/B then B/A alternation per pair, same order across all cases in a pair
method.instrumentation: Conversion wrappers and parity checks run separately before timing and are restored. Every raw warm-run sample retained, no outlier filtering.
method.dependencies: Both variants receive identical imported Babylon/budget module objects; dependency hashes cover package metadata and directly relevant engine modules, not all transitive modules

summary.interpretation: Descriptive CPU campaign. Admission uses whole-operation pair consistency and parity; nested flush gain alone is insufficient. No GPU or FPS claim.

method.scope: CPU wall time on real PhotoGrassBatch/NullEngine; no render, GPU, FPS or browser claim
method.clock: performance.now; two reads around each 65536-operation block, no per-operation clock
method.timing: Five raw blocks per control/variant, whole mutate+flush loop elapsed divided by exact operation count; nested flush is null, never inferred
method.controlsCalibration: Only no-op and fade-only. Default8192 equal warmup operations per variant in two interleaved rounds before timing; five blocks interleave variants in the pair order. Loop/JIT cost is included, not subtracted; no artificial state mutation or instrumentation. Tight-loop no-op cost is not an isolated game-frame cost. Original full campaign and acceptance threshold remain unchanged.
